description: This file defines the 'FinAccountServices' class containing service methods for handling financial account operations such as account creation, balance checks, status updates, and refunds within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: FinAccountServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for managing financial accounts, including creation, balance checking, status updating, and refund processing.

methods.name: createAccountAndCredit
methods.description: Creates a new financial account and credits it, handling account lookup or creation, role assignment, and transaction recording.

methods.name: createFinAccountForStore
methods.description: Creates a financial account associated with a given product store, automatically generating account codes and handling store-specific settings.

methods.name: checkFinAccountBalance
methods.description: Retrieves the available and actual balances for a specified financial account.

methods.name: checkFinAccountStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a financial account based on its balance, e.g., active or frozen.

methods.name: refundFinAccount
methods.description: Processes refunds for a financial account by creating return headers and adjusting account balances accordingly.
